## listOffline

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="typescript" operationID="cache_listOffline" method="get" path="/api/cache/offline" -->
```typescript
import { VibenClient } from "@viben/client-sdk";

const vibenClient = new VibenClient();

async function run() {
  await vibenClient.cache.listOffline();


}

run();
```

### Standalone function

The standalone function version of this method:

```typescript
import { VibenClientCore } from "@viben/client-sdk/core.js";
import { cacheListOffline } from "@viben/client-sdk/funcs/cacheListOffline.js";

// Use `VibenClientCore` for best tree-shaking performance.
// You can create one instance of it to use across an application.
const vibenClient = new VibenClientCore();

async function run() {
  const res = await cacheListOffline(vibenClient);
  if (res.ok) {
    const { value: result } = res;
    
  } else {
    console.log("cacheListOffline failed:", res.error);
  }
}

run();
```
